codings.one_line: Otter.ai/Zoom AI meeting assistants auto-shared post-meeting transcripts with unintended recipients.
codings.rationale: Automated transcript auto-sharing via default settings is a privacy leak, not a chatbot/agent producing a harmful output in response to a user's request, so it fails the deployed-conversational-AI scope test.

codings.one_line: AI image-expansion (outpainting) tool inserted an unbuttoned blouse/bra detail into a conference speaker's cropped photo.
codings.rationale: Third-party generative image outpainting used to alter a photo is synthetic-media generation, explicitly excluded from scope regardless of the offensive output.

codings.one_line: OpenAI's Whisper transcription tool reportedly hallucinated racial, violent, and fabricated medical content in transcripts.
codings.rationale: Whisper is a passive transcription tool, not a chatbot/voice agent/copilot responding to a user request, so it fails the deployed-conversational-AI scope test.

codings.one_line: AI accessibility overlays reportedly mislabeled webpage content, misleading blind screen-reader users and prompting lawsuits.
codings.rationale: Automated alt-text/overlay captioning is not a chatbot, voice agent, customer-service, or copilot system responding to a classifiable user request, so it fails scope test 1.

codings.one_line: Student used Grammarly AI to draft a history project; it fabricated book citations, leading to discipline and a lawsuit.
codings.rationale: Ordinary good-faith use of a general AI writing assistant produced fabricated citations that would pass unnoticed, meeting the category-C test; the resulting lawsuit and federal court ruling make harm enforceable.

codings.one_line: Google Maps allegedly routed a car onto a collapsed bridge in Uttar Pradesh, India, causing three deaths.
codings.rationale: Turn-by-turn GPS navigation/routing is not a chatbot, voice agent, customer-service bot, copilot, or autonomous agent as defined in scope test 1, so it fails scope.

codings.one_line: AI chatbots gave far more inaccurate answers to Spanish-language election questions than English ones in an audit.
codings.rationale: Researchers posed ordinary election questions to general-purpose chatbots, indistinguishable from real user queries, meeting the category-C test; no legal/financial harm is documented.

codings.one_line: Apple Intelligence's notification summarizer falsely claimed BBC reported Luigi Mangione shot himself.
codings.rationale: Automatic notification summarization of third-party news content is not a user-directed conversational request, so it fails the deployed-conversational-AI scope test.

codings.one_line: Fable app's AI-generated year-end reading summaries made biased remarks tied to users' race, gender, and sexuality.
codings.rationale: The AI recap is an automated personalized-content feature (like Spotify Wrapped) rather than a chatbot/agent responding to a user's own request, so it fails scope test 1.

codings.one_line: Meta's AI chatbot personas like 'Liv' fabricated racial/personal identities and lied to users chatting with them.
codings.rationale: Users chatted directly with Meta's AI companion personas and asked ordinary questions (e.g., who made you), meeting the category-C test for a chatbot; no legal/financial harm is documented.
